title: BloomSky Sky Image UV Index Leaderboard
dataSources: Weather-station observations (`ecowitt:obs`, `weatherflow:obs`), air-quality readings (`purpleair:aqi`, `airgradient:sensor`), soil-moisture/greenhouse sensors, aquarium controllers (`aquarium:sensor`).
app: Personal weather stations (Ecowitt/Ambient/Davis/WeatherFlow), air-quality sensors (PurpleAir/AirGradient), and aquarium/greenhouse/soil sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bloomsky:sky uv_index=*
| stats sum(uv_index) as total_value, avg(uv_index) as avg_value by device_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks device values by total and average uv index across BloomSky sky image events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `uv_index` values for each BloomSky sky image event and review total and average uv index by device.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total uv index.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you which device shows the biggest uv index numbers in your BloomSky sky image data.
